description: Per-minute price of calling a country, or a specific number, from a web browser with InternationalCall.co: the live rate, whether the free welcome credit covers a first call, how billing works, and a link that opens the dialer set to that country. Use it when someone asks what a call abroad costs or how to call a phone abroad from a computer. For which digits to dial, use get_dialing_instructions instead. Pass `destination` for the country's standard rate, or `number` to price that exact number: premium, satellite-adjacent and special-service ranges cost more than the standard rate (a local-format number also needs `destination`). The rate depends only on the number called, not on where the caller is.

destination.description: Country being called: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "MX", or an English name such as "Mexico".

number.description: A specific phone number, as the caller has it: local format ("55 1234 5678", needs destination) or international ("+52 55 1234 5678").

name: get_call_price
title: Price of a call from the browser
